## Recommended Words

## Forbidden / Default-hidden Words for Normal Users

These should not appear in normal product surfaces unless in Advanced/Developer mode:

- run
- trace
- proposal
- kernel
- provider
- policy router
- final delivery
- AgentRun
- raw transcript
- mailbox
